## What to do next (run in order)

```bash
python3 experiment_system/tools/aub_autopilot.py --registry experiment_system/config/module_registry.yaml --run --select-best
```

## What each command will produce/check

1. **`aub_autopilot.py ... --select-best`**
   - Runs module-level experiments from `module_registry.yaml`
   - Picks the best candidate (if any) relative to the current champion
   - Expectation: if nothing beats the champion robustly (esp. on lockbox), you’ll still end up with “no PASS” outcomes.

2. **`system_autopilot.py ...`**
   - Runs system-level candidates defined in `system_candidates.yaml`
   - Useful when module-level tweaks don’t move the needle but interactions might.

3. **`aub_next_fix.py ... --output ...next_fix.md`**
   - Generates a human-readable prioritized fix list based on the latest results
   - This is the artifact you hand to an engineer (or use to queue the next candidate set).

## If you paste outputs, I can help decide “select-best” correctness
If you share:
- the console output from the first two runs, and/or
- the generated `baseline/reports/next_fix.md`

…I can help interpret why nothing passed (e.g., tuning improved but lockbox regressed, instability/high variance, failing constraints) and suggest what to change in the candidate definitions next.
